plugin.note: Bloodvelds are demons using magic-based melee. Use magic-defence armour such as dragonhide or blood moon armour, pray Protect from Melee when praying, and prefer demonbane melee or cannon-supported mutated bloodveld locations for efficient tasks.

requirements: 50 Slayer is required to damage Bloodvelds.
50 combat is required to receive Bloodveld assignments.
Bigger and Badder enables Insatiable Bloodveld and Insatiable mutated Bloodveld superior spawns.
Bleed me dry extends Bloodveld assignments to 200-250.
76 Sailing is required for Buccaneers' Laboratory.
Song of the Elves is required for Iorwerth Dungeon.
Partial Sins of the Father is required for Meiyerditch Laboratories after the quest mutated bloodveld kill.
65 Magic and the Arceuus spellbook are required for Expert Reanimation.
mechanics: Bloodvelds are demons, so demonbane weapons affect them.
Bloodvelds attack with magic-based melee: their attack is melee for protection-prayer purposes, but player Magic defence is used for accuracy checks.
Protect from Melee nullifies Bloodveld damage; Protect from Magic is not the correct protection prayer.
Dragonhide and blood moon armour are useful because they provide Magic defence while fighting a melee-prayer target.
Ash sanctifier can provide Prayer experience from ashes.
Bloodvelds have high Hitpoints and low Defence, making them popular combat and Slayer experience targets.
Insatiable Bloodveld can spawn only where normal Bloodvelds can produce superior variants; God Wars variants cannot spawn the superior.
Mutated Bloodvelds have more hitpoints and better drops than normal Bloodvelds.
Reanimated bloodvelds count toward the task but give far less Slayer experience and are mainly a Prayer-training alternative.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Use Magic-defence armour, Protect from Melee, and demonbane melee or cannon-supported locations depending on assignment and access.
recommendedFor: choosing between normal Bloodvelds, mutated Bloodvelds, Konar locks, and Wilderness risk
requiredOrKeyItems: Magic-defence armour such as dragonhide or blood moon armour
steps: Equip armour with Magic defence because Bloodveld accuracy rolls against Magic defence.
Use Protect from Melee when praying, since Bloodvelds still use melee attacks.
Use demonbane melee weapons where fighting directly.
Use cannonable locations for lower attention and higher Slayer experience.
Prefer mutated Bloodvelds when the account can access good multicombat cannon spots.
Bring an ash sanctifier for passive Prayer experience if desired.
notes: Bloodvelds are good experience because they have high Hitpoints and low Defence.
Protect from Magic is the wrong protection prayer despite the Magic-defence accuracy check.

methods.label: Stronghold Slayer Cave cannon
methods.summary: Use Stronghold Slayer Cave for a nearby bank, cannon support, and straightforward normal Bloodveld kills.
recommendedFor: Nieve or Duradel assignments without better mutated Bloodveld access
requiredOrKeyItems: Slayer ring or other Tree Gnome Stronghold access
steps: Travel with a Slayer ring, Spirit tree to Tree Gnome Stronghold, or necklace of passage to the Outpost.
Set up a dwarf multicannon in the Bloodveld room.
Use Protect from Melee if taking damage.
Use demonbane melee or another strong melee weapon while the cannon handles extra hits.
notes: The task page calls Stronghold Slayer Cave the most common Bloodveld location because it is close to a bank and cannonable.

methods.label: Meiyerditch mutated cannon
methods.summary: Use Meiyerditch Laboratories for high-experience cannoned mutated Bloodvelds after partial Sins of the Father.
recommendedFor: players with Sins of the Father progress
steps: Enter the Meiyerditch Laboratories after killing the mutated bloodveld during Sins of the Father.
Use the cluster of seven mutated bloodvelds for cannon-assisted kills.
Prefer Prayer over food because the run to the laboratory is fairly long.
Take advantage of multicombat and cannon damage for high experience per hour.
notes: The page recommends Meiyerditch Laboratories under most circumstances for mutated Bloodvelds.
The area is hard to reach, but its drops can cover cannon cost.

methods.label: Buccaneers' Laboratory
methods.summary: Use Buccaneers' Laboratory as a Sailing-gated multicombat cannon alternative with cleaner Bloodveld pathing.
recommendedFor: players who have built the rowboat and bank chest
steps: Access Buccaneers' Laboratory after reaching the 76 Sailing requirement.
Build the rowboat and bank chest to make access and banking faster.
Use the multicombat room and cannon the eight mutated Bloodvelds.
Use Protect from Melee if tanking damage.
notes: The page says this location has no obstacles blocking bloodvelds.

methods.label: Slayer Tower
methods.summary: Use Slayer Tower when Konar assigns it or when Morytania Diary Slayer experience is desired.
requiredOrKeyItems: Slayer ring or fairy ring CKS access
steps: Use the first floor or basement depending on assignment and crowding.
Use Slayer ring or fairy ring CKS to reach the tower.
Safespot if desired.
Benefit from extra Slayer experience per completed Morytania Diary tier.
notes: The basement is task-only and may be less busy.

methods.label: Catacombs of Kourend
methods.summary: Use Catacombs mutated Bloodvelds mainly for Konar locks, dark totem pieces, ancient shards, and safespots.
recommendedFor: players valuing ancient shards and dark totems
players using goading potions or safespots
steps: Choose between the north-east, south-east, and south-west mutated Bloodveld groups.
Use the north-east seven-spawn cluster with a goading potion when available.
Use the south-west path to hill giants as a safespot if fighting that group.
Expect Catacombs tertiary drops such as ancient shards and dark totem pieces.
notes: The south-west area is polluted by wandering possessed pickaxes.

methods.label: Iorwerth Dungeon
methods.summary: Use Iorwerth Dungeon when assigned there by Konar or when crystal shard drops are desired.
recommendedFor: players with Song of the Elves
steps: Enter Iorwerth Dungeon after Song of the Elves.
Use either of the two six-Bloodveld sections near the cave entrance.
Use the safespot or cannon support depending on attention level.
Expect crystal shard drops from mutated Bloodvelds here.
notes: The mutated Bloodveld sections are close to the entrance, making banking and resets easier.

methods.label: Konar God Wars Dungeon
methods.summary: Skip or avoid God Wars Dungeon Bloodveld tasks when possible because superior spawns are disabled and AFK killing is impractical.
requiredOrKeyItems: Rope for first-time God Wars Dungeon access
steps: Bring Saradomin and Zamorak item protection if entering God Wars Dungeon.
Use the safespot only if choosing to complete the task there.
Consider skipping because insatiable Bloodveld cannot spawn here.
Avoid expecting AFK kills because nearby aggressive monsters interfere.
notes: The task page explicitly says God Wars Dungeon Bloodveld assignments should be skipped.

methods.label: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
methods.summary: Avoid Krystilia Bloodveld tasks when possible because Wilderness God Wars Dungeon is sparse, multicombat, and dangerous.
steps: Use minimal-risk gear because the area is multicombat Wilderness.
Use the Trollheim Agility shortcut with 64 Agility if available.
Bring an item devoted to the relevant god to reduce dungeon aggression.
Leave if player-killing risk increases.
risks: The area has player killing risk.
Spawns are sparse, lowering overall rates.
The superior version cannot spawn here.
notes: The task page says Krystilia Bloodveld assignments are not recommended.

methods.label: Reanimated bloodveld
methods.summary: Use Expert Reanimation on ensouled bloodveld heads only as a Prayer-training alternative with much lower Slayer and combat experience.
steps: Cast Expert Reanimation on an ensouled bloodveld head soon after it drops.
If too much time passes, or the head is traded or teleported away, reanimate it at the Dark Altar.
Kill the reanimated bloodveld for task progress, 35 Slayer experience, and 1,040 Prayer experience.
notes: This method gives much less Slayer and combat experience than normal Bloodveld kills.

styleOptions.label: Melee demonbane
styleOptions.summary: Use demonbane melee against Bloodvelds while wearing Magic-defence armour and praying Protect from Melee when needed.

styleOptions.label: Ranged cannon or safespot
styleOptions.summary: Use ranged gear for safespots or while cannoning in supported locations.

styleOptions.label: Magic safespot
styleOptions.summary: Use powered staves or other Magic gear only when safespotting or choosing a Magic training method.
